As someone that lived through The Tech Bubble bursting, I can tell you this is a very different bubble. I would say the biggest difference is during The Tech Bubble retail investors just gained unprecedented access to trading stocks on their own and they had almost no education to do so. Youtube wasn't big. Everyone wanted in the stock market and everyone was able to get in the stock market like never before. The first trade I made prior to the internet boom was going to a broker at Merrill-Lynch and being charged 5% to have them purchase two stocks I picked. Microsoft and some biotech cancer company. I made money on both. I didn't have much back then, but I ran 1500 into 33,000 in five years from about 1995 to the burst. That is 2200 percent in 5 years. I should have added more capital, but it was so easy to make money in the stock market on almost anything you didn't feel like you needed to add more. Then pop, everything crashed. The sad thing was I had sold out prior to the crash and got back in because the market kept going up. Got rocked, lost 90 percent. Then you started wanting to get that money back and gambling. Killed me. The Tech Bubble is not this market. The people in quite a few AI stocks are going to get wrecked when The AI Bubble pops because AI stocks are a mix of greatly overvalued and a little bit overvalued. But fundamentals are far better now in most AI companies than they were in internet companies and retail investors are much better at investing now. Lots more education available than existed during The Tech Bubble when the first online traders made investing accessible and cheaper but had no real education on how to invest. There are a lot of places in this market that are downright undervalued, wrecked stocks that still have good fundamentals that are being overlooked as everyone piles in AI. If the AI bubble pops and the good stocks get hammered with the AI stocks, I'm going to be buying up a storm. The fundamentals of a bunch of non-AI stocks and even a few AI stocks like Google and Amazon are still looking great even if the AI bubble pops.
